evidence_excerpt: - role: read channel metrics, separate reach vs conversion, propose experiments and packaging changes
1. Shorts feed is the dominant distribution surface.
2. The audience is mostly unsubscribed, so the channel has discovery but weak conversion.
3. Concrete workplace-problem videos drive reach best.
4. Emotionally sharp identity-level topics appear better at subscriber conversion.
5. LinkedIn is a plausible secondary distribution surface for this niche.
